Iconic Framework

15,000+ CSS Classes Documentation

Getting Started

How to include Iconic Framework in your project

<!-- CDN -->
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/junaidprodeveloper/Iconic/iconic-framework.css">

<!-- Local -->
<link rel="stylesheet" href="iconic-framework.css">
Getting Started

Option 1: CDN (jsDelivr)
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/junaidprodeveloper/Iconic/iconic-framework.css">

Option 2: CDN (cdnjs)
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/iconic/iconic-framework.css">

Option 3: Download
Download iconic-framework.css from GitHub and link locally.

GitHub: https://github.com/junaidprodeveloper/Iconic

CSS Reset

Iconic Framework includes a CSS reset/normalize

/* Included automatically */
/* Box-sizing reset */
* { box-sizing: border-box; }
/* Margin/padding reset */
body { margin: 0; padding: 0; }
/* Image reset */
img { max-width: 100%; height: auto; }
CSS Reset

The framework includes a comprehensive reset:
- box-sizing: border-box on all elements
- margin/padding reset on body
- font-family reset to system fonts
- img max-width: 100%
- a text-decoration: none
- button cursor: pointer
- table border-collapse: collapse
- input/button font inheritance

Naming Convention

Understanding the ic- prefix pattern

/* All classes use ic- prefix */
.ic-text-red-500    /* text color */
.ic-bg-blue-500     /* background color */
.ic-padding-4       /* spacing */
.ic-rounded-lg      /* border radius */
.ic-flex            /* display flex */
.ic-font-bold      /* font weight */
Naming Convention

All classes use the ic- prefix followed by category and value:

Colors:    ic-text-{hue}-{shade}, ic-bg-{hue}-{shade}
Spacing:   ic-margin-{val}, ic-padding-{val}
Layout:    ic-d-{type}, ic-flex, ic-grid-cols-{n}
Visual:    ic-border-{w}, ic-rounded-{size}, ic-shadow-{size}
Effects:   ic-opacity-{pct}, ic-blur-{size}, ic-rotate-{deg}
Fonts:     ic-font-{name}, ic-font-{weight}, ic-{size}

Hover variants: add -hover suffix
  ic-bg-blue-500-hover

Responsive: add breakpoint prefix
  ic-md-d-flex, ic-lg-text-center

Important! Flag

All utility classes use !important for deterministic styling

/* In iconic-framework.css */
.ic-text-red-500 {
    color: #ef4444 !important;
}
.ic-padding-4 {
    padding: 1rem !important;
}
Important Flag

All utility classes in Iconic Framework use !important:
- Ensures utilities always override component styles
- Prevents specificity wars
- Matches Bootstrap utility API pattern
- Enables predictable composition

Example:
<button class="ic-btn ic-btn-primary ic-bg-green-500">
  -> button will be green (utility wins over component)

Color System Overview

Complete color system with 23 hues and 40+ named colors

/* Hue shades (23 hues x 11 shades = 253 colors) */
red, orange, amber, yellow, lime, green, emerald, teal,
cyan, sky, blue, indigo, violet, purple, fuchsia, pink, rose,
brown, slate, gray, stone, zinc, neutral

/* Named colors (40+) */
red, crimson, firebrick, darkred, orange, coral, tomato,
gold, yellow, green, lime, forestgreen, olive, blue, royalblue,
deepskyblue, steelblue, purple, indigo, violet, magenta,
pink, deeppink, hotpink, black, white, gray, silver, brown, ...
Color System

23 Hues x 11 Shades (50-950) = 253 colors per category
40+ Named colors

Categories using colors:
  Text:       ic-text-{hue}-{shade}
  Background: ic-bg-{hue}-{shade}
  Border:     ic-border-{hue}-{shade}
  Ring:       ic-ring-{1-3}-{hue}-{300|500|700}
  Shadow:     ic-shadow-{hue}-{400|500|600}
  Outline:    ic-outline-{1-3}-{hue}-{shade}
  Caret:      ic-caret-{hue}-{shade}
  Accent:     ic-accent-{hue}-{shade}
  Selection:  ic-{hue}-{shade}-selection
  Focus:      ic-focus-{hue}-{shade}

Total color classes: 2,500+

Dark Mode Overview

Dark mode utilities using ic-dark- prefix

<div class="ic-dark-bg-gray-900 ic-dark-text-white">
  Dark mode background and text
</div>
<div class="ic-dark-d-block ic-d-none">
  Visible only in dark mode
</div>
Dark Mode

Prefix: ic-dark-

The framework supports dark mode via a .dark class on <html> or <body>.
When .dark is present, ic-dark-* utilities activate.

Examples:
  ic-dark-bg-gray-900       (dark bg)
  ic-dark-text-white        (dark text color)
  ic-dark-d-block           (show in dark)
  ic-dark-d-none            (hide in dark)

Toggle: document.documentElement.classList.toggle("dark")

Print Utilities

Print-specific utilities using ic-print- prefix

<div class="ic-print-d-none">Hidden when printing</div>
<div class="ic-print-d-block">Visible only when printing</div>
<div class="ic-print-text-black">Black text when printing</div>
Print Utilities

Prefix: ic-print-

Examples:
  ic-print-d-none           (hide when printing)
  ic-print-d-block          (show when printing)
  ic-print-text-black       (black text when printing)
  ic-print-text-white       (white text when printing)

These use @media print { } to apply styles only when printing.
